title: Sparkles
description: Twinkling points of light scattered over a line of type — celebration, kept quiet.
usage: The script scatters about two dozen specks inside the stage and each twinkles on its own clock. Dots take the container’s color (currentColor), so the same part sparkles white over a hero and ink over a card. Keep the count low and the stage honest — sparkle is seasoning.
a11y: Decoration only, aria-hidden, and the twinkle stops under prefers-reduced-motion. The text it decorates must read complete with every speck removed — it will be, for some readers.
